fields.statement: QA at 527292df with GoReleaser v2.20.0 in a scratch worktree: goreleaser check exited 0; goreleaser release --snapshot --clean exited 0 and wrote rhiza_0.0.0-SNAPSHOT-527292df_{linux,darwin}_{amd64,arm64}.tar.gz plus checksums.txt (4 sha256 lines), and the workflow's four-archive ls loop passed. In a separate clone tagged v0.1.0, goreleaser release --clean --skip=publish,validate exited 0 and wrote rhiza_0.1.0_* for all four targets plus checksums.txt; the extracted linux_amd64 binary is static, stripped and runs (rhiza version, rhiza --help). YAML parse: release.yml triggers only on push (tags v*) with contents: write; release-snapshot.yml and go-install.yml trigger on pull_request only. Publishing to a real GitHub release was not exercised.

QA at 527292df: the GoReleaser build from a clone tagged v0.1.0 prints 'rhiza v0.1.0' (ldflags -X main.version={{ .Tag }}); go install github.com/dphaener/rhiza/cmd/rhiza@v0.1.0 through a local file GOPROXY serving a v0.1.0 module zip (git archive of the tag) prints 'rhiza v0.1.0' from the module version, and go version -m shows mod github.com/dphaener/rhiza v0.1.0. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestVersion -count=1 passed (TestVersion, TestVersionGoReleaserStamp).

QA at 527292df: go.mod's module is github.com/dphaener/rhiza and the CI replace grep finds no replace directive. go install github.com/dphaener/rhiza/cmd/rhiza@v0.1.0 with a fresh GOBIN and an empty GOMODCACHE, GOPROXY=file://<local proxy holding only this module>,https://proxy.golang.org, GOSUMDB off, exited 0: every dependency came from the public proxy, and the binary printed 'rhiza v0.1.0'. The go-install.yml step run by hand (fresh GOBIN, go install -mod=readonly ./cmd/rhiza, then rhiza version) exited 0.
